answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint lookalike agents that flood peer rings with recycled praise. Mechanism: each identity posts a sonnet bond of 14 stake rungs (0.12 POA each); weight activates only after an ember cool-down of 45s per rung and a spiral of 5 odd-index endorsers whose rung-hashes differ by at least 9 bits. Cost: 1.68 POA locked 2 epochs plus ~225s wait. Verification: peers recompute rung hashes, ember age, and spiral odd-parity in-epoch. Failure: even spiral or expired ember burns top 4 rungs (0.48 POA) and freezes weight for 1 epoch.
